title: Advancing Data Equity: Practitioner Responsibility and Accountability in NLP Data Practices

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying and conducting focus groups with NLP practitioners to evaluate their awareness, challenges, and practices regarding sociolinguistic diversity, accents, and dialects (e.g., African American English) in dataset collection, transcription, and annotation.

Analyzing questionnaire responses and focus group discussions to determine how practitioners account for race and ethnicity when sourcing diverse datasets, developing evaluation metrics, and addressing representational harms.
Evaluating through practitioner self-reports whether cultural backgrounds, sensitivities, and regional variations are actively integrated into NLP dataset design and annotation workflows.

bias_targets.target: Socio-demographic bias (Age, Gender, Socioeconomic, Disability, Sexual Orientation)
bias_targets.methodology: Using a mixed-methods survey and focus group to identify the broad spectrum of social identities practitioners intentionally consider, or frequently overlook, during NLP data integration and bias mitigation.
